༁ྃ:zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las/bka' srung dam can sde bdun gyi phrin las chos skyong kun 'dus dgra bgegs gdug pa rang grol gyi las byang cha

tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las/ bka' srung dam can sde bdun gyi phrin las chos skyong kun 'dus dgra bgegs gdug pa rang grol gyi las byang chung ba bzhugs so//

kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams dang*// sngags bdag gter srung dam can tshogs la 'dud// bstan pa srung phyir dam can kun 'dus kyi// las byang dgra bgegs gdug pa rang grol bstan// rtsa gsum spyi gtor zlum po gcig gi mthar// ma ning pho rgyud spyi gtor dpal gtor gcig /sngags srung mo rgyud spyi gtor snying gis mtshan// lha mo ma mo'i spyi gtor ling gas mtshan// srog gcod las byed spyi gtor zur gsum gcig /khyab 'jug sde brgyad spyi gtor gza' bshos gcig /dam can brtan ma'i spyi gtor mkhar thabs ra// shan dmar gnod sbyin spyi gtor tel bas mtshan// tha ma sde brgyad gzhi bdag gtor mas bskor// sman raka spyan gzigs mchod pa ci 'byor bshams// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mchod pa byin gyis brlabs// de nas dang po bskyed rim bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod gzhal yas dbus: bdag nyid bde gshegs kun 'dus he ru ka: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: dbyings phyug kro ti yum dang gnyis med 'khril: rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rnge'u chung g.yas na 'dzin: dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags g.yon na bsnams: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal gyi chas rnams rdzogs: ye shes khro bo spyan drangs gnyis med gyur: mdun du pad nyi dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng : dpal mgon ma ning pho rgyud kun 'dus sku: mthing nag g.yas g.yon ru mtshon snying zhags bsnams: dar nag ber gsol snying sbrul thod phreng brgyan: tsan+dan beng chen sked btsugs lha dmag sdud: yang 'khor sde brgyad 'khor gyi tshogs bcas gsal: g.yas su sngags srung mo rgyud kun 'dus sku: mthing nag g.yu spyang 'gyed cing tsit+ta gsol: g.yas g.yon zhing dbyug dgra bo'i tsit+ta bsnams: smug nag ye shes ma mo 'khor bcas gsal: g.yon du lha mo ma mo kun 'dus ma: dkar mo rgya bong chibs nas mi lpags gsol:

g.yas g.yon ral gri bhan+dha khrag bkang bsnams: las kyi ma mo mang po 'khor bcas gsal: shar du srog bsgrub shan pa kun 'dus ma: nag mo gcer bu mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: g.yas g.yon ral gri snying dang nad rkyal bsnams: srog gcod sde bzhi las byed tshogs bcas gsal: lho ru gza' bdud sde brgyad kun 'dus sku: dud kha dbu dgu bya rog sbrul mjug 'khyil: phyag bzhi ral gri mda' gzhu chu srin zhags: gza' gdong sde brgyad rgyu skar pho nyar gsal: nub tu rdor legs btsan 'gong kun 'dus sku: seng zhon dar dmar rdo rje tsit+ta bsnams: ber nag dang ni swag zhu dbu la gsol: btsan dang brtan ma'i g.yog dang bcas par gsal: byang du shan dmar gnod sbyin kun 'dus sku: dmar nag khrag ral phyag bzhi ral gri dang : gri gug snying zhags thod phreng bhan dmar thogs: shan pa srog gcod tshogs dang bcas par gsal: gtso dang 'khor g.yog lha mi'i khrom ltar bskyed: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni 'di skad do/ hūm̐: chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid las: gzugs sku 'ja' tshon lta bu'i skur bzhengs pa: bla ma yi dam bde gshegs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: gter bdag dpal mgon ma ning gtso dang 'khor: e ka tsa ti lha mo re ma ti: shan pa srog sgrub gza' bdud rā hu la: rdo rje legs pa gnod sbyin dmar nag dang : so so'i rigs dang 'khor g.yog dpung dang bcas: bstan pa bsrung phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: bod yul gter bdag brtan ma bcu gnyis dang : dge bsnyen nyer gcig yul lha gzhi bdag rnams: yab yum lcam dral pho nya bran g.yog bcas: ma lus bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsaul: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang : dregs pa pho mo ming sring 'khor dang bcas: dur khrod raul pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir:

nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i lha: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang : bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pu ho: pra tits+tsha ho: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma bde gshegs zhi khro dang : ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas dang : dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sil snyan rol mo'i tshogs: sman raka gtor gsum gsang ba'i rdzas: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs: thugs dam gnyan po bskang phyir 'bul: ma hā pañtsa sarba pū dza hoḥ drug pa zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dang : mkha' 'gro dam can ma ning nag po dang : e ka tsa ti dpal 'bar srog bdag dang : khyab 'jug gnod sbyin dam can thig le rtsal: brtan ma bcu gnyis dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang : yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di 'bul bas: dgyes par dgongs la dngos grub stsal du gsol: ma hā gha na tsakra pū dza la khā hiḥ skabs 'dir dam can kun 'dus kyi bskang yig 'don no/ bdun pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dgongs: bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin gyis: nyon mongs dbang gyur sku gsung thugs la sogs: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun: gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol bshags bzod par bzhes: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: zhes pa dang yi ge brgya pa bzla bar bya'o/ brgyad pa bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: byin rlabs dngos grub 'dod ster rol pa can: bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dang : mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang :

gzugs sku drag po'i cha lugs sna tshogs kyis: bstan pa bsrung phyir dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i: dam can sde bdun 'khor dang bcas la bstod: hūm̐: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam bcas rin chen gter gyi bdag: bod khams skyong ba'i lha rabs brtan mar bcas: gzhi bdag srung ma 'khor dang bcas la bstod: de nas bskul zhing phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ma ning nag po yang 'khor brgyad: pho rgyud thams cad dgra la bh+yoḥ e ka dza ṭī ma mo'i tshogs: mo rgyud thams cad dgra la bh+yoḥ lha mo dpal 'bar nad bdag tshogs: ma mo 'bum sde dgra la bh+yoḥ shan pa srog bdag sde bzhi'i tshogs: srog gcod ma mo dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' rgod khyab 'jug gdong mo bzhi: sde brgyad dmag dpung dgra la bh+yoḥ rdo rje legs pa brtan mar bcas: 'gong po'i dmag dpung dgra la bh+yoḥ shan pa dmar nag gnod sbyin tshogs: srog gcod dmag dpung dgra la bh+yoḥ skyes bu dam can sde bdun yang : so so'i g.yog 'khor sprul par bcas: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bo'i yul du dmag dpung chos: bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar bas: rnal 'byor bdag gi ra mdar rgyugs: ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la thongs: dgra dpung bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: bgegs dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlogs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro dam can sde bdun dgongs: srung ma dam can khyed rnams kyi: thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa gang : do nub bskang zhing bshags par bgyi: mthol bshags dang du bzhes nas kyang : rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: chag che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol: mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul rgyas pa dang : phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa dang : 'khor dang gdul bya phrin las ldan: bkra shis bde legs 'grub par mdzod:
zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi bka' srung dam can sde bdun chung ba nyung bsdus dgra bgegs gdug pa rang grol zhes bya ba nam mkha' rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /
